5.50.c: Four Boolean input points fall onto the unit square, and AND and OR are each cut by a single stroke. The truth table hangs in the back.

8.60.c: The perceptron's wiring: x₁, x₂ → Σ → step → ŷ, with Rosenblatt's update rule typeset below.

12.33.c: XOR. The EPOCH and ERRORS counters never reach zero: no single line separates the four points.

15.60.c: SOLVED ✓. Each point is lifted to its hidden-layer coordinates (h₁ = OR, h₂ = NAND), where one cut separates them.

17.54.c: SIGMOID on the oscilloscope: a big input sine is squeezed into the narrow band (0, 1).

18.49.c: A gradient light runs backwards from LOSS through six sigmoid stages, losing × ¼ at each one.

19.50.c: ZERO. By the input end, the gradient has vanished: 0.25⁸ ≈ 0.000015.

22.12.c: The same chain with ReLU: × 1 at every stage, so the gradient arrives at full strength.

27.01.c: HOG engraved on a copper plate: a 9-direction gradient histogram per 8 × 8 cell, with the SIFT descriptor panel beside it.

28.00.c: CONVOLUTION: a learned kernel slides across the plate and the feature map fills in row by row.

30.50.c: NOBODY PLANNED: 96 real conv1 filters trained on CIFAR-10. Test accuracy 88.3% after 30 epochs.

32.76.c: SVM: the fences push outward until they touch three support posts. The dial reads the margin 2/‖w‖.

34.41.c: KERNEL TRICK: pistons lift each post by x₁² + x₂², and a flat blade then separates the rings.

36.03.c: DEEP NETS: ImageNet top-5 error, 2010–2015. Magenta marks AlexNet's 2012.

44.50.c: NEED at the bottom of a 152-floor shaft, ResNet's depth. The black-glass stele is laser-engraved GUARANTEED.

47.53.c: The champion's board: STATE OF THE ART above a real leaderboard (ImageNet top-5 error).

49.50.c: BASELINE: the old champion's nameplate hits the floor at y = 0 and magenta floods out from the impact.

52.80.c: DEADLINE: the title board turns into a countdown and hits 00:00.00, the next submission deadline.

55.26.c: Kernel tricks and hand-made features in a freezer: RBF, polynomial, SIFT, HOG, Haar, Gabor, LBP, bag of words.

59.39.c: The crown flies to the network, whose layers learn edges, textures, parts and classes on their own. Nobody wrote those rules.

63.38.c: N-GRAM: a gantry three cars wide slides along the night train, counting.

64.60.c: RNN: a crane reads one car at a time. Its 8 LEDs are a real tanh RNN's hidden state.

70.50.c: VANISH or EXPLODE: behind the crane the track forks, one branch falling to 10⁻²⁰ and the other climbing.

74.05.c: LSTM: forget, input and output barriers beside every car, opened by a real LSTM's gate values.

77.20.c: SEQ2SEQ: the sentence's cars roll into the encoder funnel.

78.00.c: BOTTLENECK: the whole sentence squeezed into one glowing vector c ∈ ℝ⁶⁴.

81.80.c: ATTENTION: a real α heatmap on the floor. The anti-diagonal means the sentence was reversed.

84.00.c: RECURRENCE: one car per beat through a turnstile, t = 1, 2, 3 …

87.70.c: TRANSFORMERS: every car appears at once, with arcs between every pair.

102.85.c: Chorus 2's leaderboard: WMT14 English→German BLEU. The new champion is TRANSFORMER (BIG), 28.4.

105.90.c: The LSTM cell: the cell-state highway on top, σ σ tanh σ gates below.

111.21.c: One attention layer lands like a glass slab on the line of LSTM cells.

113.50.c: GONE: the recurrent loops snap. The slab is engraved softmax(QKᵀ/√dₖ)V.

121.50.c: GAN court: 25 target modes are light wells, the generator's distribution is the magenta terrain, and G and D are the two players.

122.90.c: COLLAPSED: the terrain folds into one spike and the other wells go dark. MODES 01/25.

124.90.c: DENOISE: each word condenses out of noise along a real DDPM trajectory. The odometer counts t.

126.85.c: A corridor of intermediate steps, from t = 1000 down to 0.

127.75.c: SINUSOIDS: the sinusoidal position-encoding wall, 40 positions × 16 dimensions.

129.90.c: ROPE: each ring of the tunnel is a position m, with eight frequency needles turned by m·θᵢ.

131.51.c: LAYERNORM → RMS: 16 real residual activations, centered and scaled, then only scaled.

133.49.c: SWIGLU: the activation tube bends from ReLU into Swish, minimum −0.278 at x = −1.278.

136.62.c: EXPERTS: for each word a real top-2 router lights two of eight expert towers.

139.05.c: 32 → 4 bits: the bit wall sheds its plates as real fp32 weights snap to INT4.

140.79.c: THROUGHPUT: the memory bar shrinks × 8 and the tokens/s gauge swings over.

144.56.c: LORA: thin B and A plates lay a rank-8 patch over the frozen W. 65,536 trainable, 0.39%.

146.30.c: IN CONTEXT: a few-shot prompt ribbon on the floor, and the model fills in the last row.

147.80.c: ∇θL falls through the floor. The frozen block reads NOT COMPUTED.

151.50.c: Four bricks rise: ATTENTION'S · ALL · YOU · NEED, with real attention arcs between them.

161.07.c: Chorus 3's leaderboard: LAMBADA accuracy. The new champion is 175B DECODER · FEW-SHOT, 86.4.

164.49.c: BERT: a row of glass tokens with one [MASK]. Beams read in from both ends to fill it.

166.00.c: MASKED AND BIDIRECTIONAL: the full attention square, where every token sees every token.

168.20.c: DECODER-ONLY: the causal triangle grows across the floor, 117M → 1.5B → 175B.

172.64.c: RLHF: answers A–D pass a REWARD MODEL scanner and get fitted Bradley–Terry scores.

174.80.c: DPO: a crane lifts the reward model, the middleman, off the conveyor.

177.13.c: The vault: β log Z(x) appears on both sides and cancels. That's why DPO needs no reward model.

179.00.c: FLASHATTENTION: a real 64 × 64 score matrix cut into 16 × 16 tiles, moved on-chip one tile at a time.

183.00.c: HBM: standard attention's 4,325,376 memory accesses jam the road; the tiles flow freely.

186.50.c: CONTEXT WINDOW: the song's own BPE tokens as tape, the window doubling from 2,048 to 1,048,576.

189.77.c: NEEDLE: at the far end of the tape, token 0, the P of PERCEPTRON.

191.68.c: The retrieval map, context length × needle depth, all green.

198.88.c: The records' staircase on real dates: each claim stands on its paper's publication day.

202.00.c: SCALE: a power-law line on log–log axes, one order of magnitude per beat.

211.64.c: Chorus 4's leaderboard: parameter count. The new champion is a 540B DENSE DECODER.

215.80.c: QUADRATIC: the attention square on the floor. n doubles on every beat and n² quadruples.

220.45.c: A LINEAR-TIME SUCCESSOR: a scan head at constant speed with a fixed-size state, O(n).

224.00.c: The four 'all you need' claims shrink into numbered footnotes.

227.00.c: A memorial wall of every name the film sang, PERCEPTRON to FLASHATTENTION.

236.33.c: The tower of champions: PERCEPTRON 1958 at the bottom, SELF-ATTENTION 2017 wearing the crown.

246.90.c: The plotter returns and draws a new line next to the old one.
